{{Top|leg}}
'''Ahto Luxury Resorts''' was a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in [[Ahto City/Legends|East Ahto]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]]. It was run by [[Olodondo Berzix]], and was advertised in the ''[[Guide to Beautiful Manaan]]''. However, the descriptions bore little semblance to the reality: bad [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], polluted [[Water/Legends|water]], cheating [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] dealers, decrepit facilities, and a large criminal population. [[Zavol Shan]] stayed there only once, in [[Bungalow 17]].

The hotel was destroyed, and its patrons [[Death/Legends|killed]], in the [[Battle of Ahto]].
